text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: decode/streaming GPU memory errors in us-west-2 pool. Spike started ~now. Auto-pager triggered to @tess.m and oncall rotation. Nodes restarting intermittently. Possible runaway generation (max_tokens missing). :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Symptoms: CUDA OOM on decode containers, container restarts, partial request drops (5-10%), increased 5xx. Auto-retries causing amplification.

oncall-bot: Metrics snapshot: error-rate +7%, avg latency +120ms, GPU mem pressure >92% cluster-wide.

Tess.m: on it. pulling logs now, switching to triage channel. @sanjay can you pull the recent config rollout for streaming-route-53?

sanjay: grabbing rollout. looks like a recent client SDK change removed client-side max_tokens in some traffic cohorts. routing rule traffic_weight=10% to new sdk.

kai: that matches — saw a surge of long-tail requests with token counts >2000. Many requests had no max_tokens header.

Tess.m: priority mitigation: 1) enforce server-side max_tokens ceiling (soft cap 1024) for streaming route, 2) enable fallback to quantized cpu model for suspicious sessions, 3) throttle new sdk traffic by lowering weight to 0.

Tess.m: Applying server-side hard cap now via feature flag.

sanjay: command ready: \
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/flags/set \
  -d '{"feature":"enforce_max_tokens","route":"streaming-v2","value":1024}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

sanjay: patch returned 200, feature rollout started.

kai: enabling fallback routing to cpu-quantized variant for long requests. patching router: \
```
kubectl -n serving patch configmap routing --type merge -p '{"data":{"fallback_model":"stream-q8h-cpu"}}'
```

kai: router picked up config, fallback traffic ~enabled.

Tess.m: rolling back SDK routing weight for the new cohort to 0. `trafficctl set stream-route-53 weight 0` executed. Confirming.
\ops-notify: Drafting customer-facing note for any customers seeing increased timeouts/drops. Will queue for review.
\support-sam: We have two customers (acme-payments, quickchat) reporting increased failed responses. Opening tickets and linking incident.

Tess.m: Quick check on affected counts: preliminary estimate ~12k requests in last 32m, ~520 errors flagged as OOM/dropped. Low % but high visible impact for some tenants.

kai: Log snippet from one crashed pod: 
```
E tensorflow: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
Stack: at decoder.cc:1423 decode_kernel()
Request metadata: {"client_sdk":"js-2.1.0","max_tokens":null,"stream":true}
```

Tess.m: Good capture. This confirms missing max_tokens. Also seeing retries causing larger KV growth and triggering paging in runtime.

sanjay: Actioned autoscale to add 2 gpus to decode-pool as temporary capacity to reduce immediate failures. `infractl scale decode-pool --add 2` -> accepted.

Tess.m: Monitoring dashboards — mem pressure dropping to ~80% after flag and fallback. Error rate trending down.

kai: Note: fallback to cpu model increases latency but prevents OOM. Good for availability tradeoff.

Tess.m: ETA for stabilization: 10-15m. If stable, we'll keep server cap and fallback, and prepare a durable fix: prevent routing cohorts from removing client-enforced max_tokens and add CI check.

ops-notify: Customer update draft: 
"We experienced elevated errors for streaming requests due to some requests missing token limits leading to GPU memory exhaustion. We applied a server-side cap and a fallback model; errors are decreasing. No data loss expected. Follow-up postmortem will be shared."

support-sam: Sent interim updates to acme-payments and quickchat, both acknowledged and prefer status emails rather than calls.

oncall-bot: Pager escalation timer reset. No further automatic escalations for now.

Tess.m: handing off to @sanjay for overnight watch — I'll stay available for questions but I need to hand off in 12m. Key tasks for handoff: keep cap, monitor fallback rate, roll back only after 24h stability, run test harness that simulates missing max_tokens.

sanjay: ack. I'll own overnight. I'll also queue a hotfix PR to server-side request validator to default max_tokens to 512 if absent for streaming routes.

Tess.m: Quick ops note for post-incident: 1) add pre-deploy check to prevent SDK routing without token enforcement, 2) add alert that correlates high request token tail with OOM, 3) add non-retry policy for flagged OOM errors to avoid amplification.

kai: capturing all logs and timeline into the incident doc. linking to runbook and the hotfix PR once created.

ops-notify: External update sent to affected customers at 4105558200.

support-sam: closing first-level tickets as we see errors drop below alert threshold. Customers will be updated during morning cadence.

Tess.m: thanks team. great quick coordination. marking incident as mitigated but staying open for postmortem. :thumbsup:

sanjay: overnight note: if error-rate rises >2% again, consider reverting new sdk cohort entirely and scale decode-pool by 3 GPUs before touching prod router.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATION: server-side cap applied, fallback enabled, autoscale +2 GPUs. Status: stabilizing.
